comment: Downloadable offline map areas. bbox = [west, south, east, north]. 'parent' = ISO code of the country an area belongs to. maxzoom is the most detail wanted; the workflow lowers it when a file would exceed 2 GB. estimatedMB: measured size, 0 = not measured yet (the app then reads catalog.json). Countries and states from Natural Earth (public domain).
